rival.clock: No rival: you're racing the clock
tutorial.title: How to play
tutorial.accelerate.title: Accelerate
tutorial.accelerate.hold: Hold your finger anywhere on the screen to accelerate. On a computer, the space bar.
tutorial.accelerate.release: There's no brake: let go and the car slows down little by little.
tutorial.lanes.title: Change lanes
tutorial.lanes.swipe: Swipe to one side to move one lane, without letting go of the throttle. On a computer, the ← → arrows.
tutorial.lanes.chain: To chain two, pause your finger for a moment or lift it.
tutorial.lanes.wall: Swipe into the wall and you bounce back, losing a little speed.
tutorial.junctions.title: Turn at junctions
tutorial.junctions.only: You can only turn at junctions: swipe towards the exit as you enter.
tutorial.junctions.timing: Timing picks your lane: early, inside; late, outside. Too late and you hit the wall and the car turns by itself, losing time.
tutorial.funnels.title: Watch the funnels
tutorial.funnels.what: Sometimes the track goes from 5 to 3 lanes. Arrows and yellow panels warn you.
tutorial.funnels.move: If your lane is closing, move over early: against the wall you scrape and slow down more and more.
tutorial.rival.title: Race a rival
tutorial.rival.ghost: The see-through ship is your rival's ghost: it replays their best lap, and the top of the screen shows how far ahead you are. Before racing you choose who to race:
tutorial.rival.top: No. 1: the fastest driver in the world on that map.
tutorial.rival.above: Next up: the driver just above you on the leaderboard, the one you can catch.
tutorial.rival.mine: Your best: your own best lap, to beat yourself.
